scripts.build:treecrdt-sqlite-ext: cd ../.. && cargo build -p treecrdt-sqlite-ext --target wasm32-unknown-emscripten --release --no-default-features --features static-link
scripts.build:wa-sqlite: make -C wa-sqlite dist VPATH=.. CFILES_EXTRA="treecrdt-ext.c ../../../target/wasm32-unknown-emscripten/release/libtreecrdt_sqlite_ext.a" && mkdir -p dist && cp wa-sqlite/dist/*.mjs wa-sqlite/dist/*.wasm dist/
scripts.build: pnpm run build:treecrdt-sqlite-ext && pnpm run build:wa-sqlite
scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
